author_source: project/高校实验室安全/117_激光加工材料与烟尘/src.py

points.K3: 每次登记，查实物和凭证

points.S1: 加工烟尘是职业病危害因素

shots.scene: 欣欣一手拿木板，一手拿透明塑料板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a wooden board in one paw and a clear plastic sheet in the other, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光加工的材料和烟尘。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一块从家里找来的、没有标签的仿皮板到签到台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student brings an unlabelled leather-look sheet from home to the sign in desk.
shots.narration: 阿杰带来一块家里找的仿皮板。

shots.scene: 小研翻看板子，找不到任何标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the sheet over and finds no label or receipt.
shots.narration: 没有标签，也说不清是什么材质。

shots.scene: 小研摇头，把板子放到一边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head kindly and sets the sheet aside.
shots.narration: 很多人造革含氯，不能进机。

shots.scene: 材料和安全两块拼图拼在一起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two jigsaw pieces, a material sheet and a safety shield, fitting together. No text.
shots.narration: 材料和安全，是分不开的两件事。

shots.scene: 对的材料切得干净，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an approved sheet being cut cleanly inside a laser cutter, with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 材料对、方法对，切割才安全。

shots.scene: 错的材料起火、冒臭烟、放出有害气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrong sheet catching fire and giving off foul smoke and toxic gas clouds, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 材料错了，会起火、发臭、放毒气。

shots.section_title: 先看许可材料清单，不看软件预设
shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白的许可材料清单
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank approved materials list posted on the wall beside a laser cutter, with tick and cross columns. No text.
shots.narration: 场所会公布一份许可材料清单。
overlay: 先看许可材料清单，不看软件预设

shots.section_title: 先看许可材料清单，不看软件预设
shots.scene: 清单上每种材料旁有凭证图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each row of the list showing a material icon and a matching proof icon such as a label or receipt. No text.
shots.narration: 能用什么、要什么凭证，都写在上面。

shots.section_title: 先看许可材料清单，不看软件预设
shots.scene: 软件材料库里一长串，清单上只勾几项
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long material menu on a computer screen beside a short approved list, only a few items matching. No text.
shots.narration: 软件里有预设，不等于允许加工。

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 签到台，小研看材料实物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student examines a sheet of material at the sign in desk.
shots.narration: 每次使用，先登记，查看材料实物。
overlay: 每次登记，查实物和凭证

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 【实拍】管理人员核对板材包装上的材质标签和购买凭证（遮挡品牌和商家）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands checking the material label on a wrapped board and a receipt beside it.
shots.narration: 还要看写明材质的标签或凭证。

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 家里找来的、没标签的板子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: unlabelled scraps and boards from home piled on a desk, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 来路不明的材料，一律不进机。

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 从整箱里单拿出的一张光板，没有字，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single plain board taken out of a box without any label, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 就算本身安全，没凭证也不能用。

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 小研做出判断，阿杰点头接受
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes the call and the young male student nods and accepts it.
shots.narration: 能否进机，管理人员说了算。

shots.scene: 几种木板，清单上标着允许的木种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several wooden boards, the approved wood types marked on the list with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 木材按清单选木种，标签写明木种。

shots.scene: 树脂多的木板冒出大火苗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a resin rich board flaring up with a big flame, with a warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 树脂多的木材，易燃、烟大。

shots.scene: 胶合板打勾，密度板和掺杂多的板打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a labelled plywood sheet with a tick, a fibreboard and a mixed filler board crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 标明的胶合板可以，密度板不行。

shots.scene: 干净的纸板打勾，带油墨胶水的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clean paper and cardboard with a tick, cardboard with ink, stains and glue crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 纸和纸板，要干净、无油墨无胶。

shots.scene: 两块透明板：浇铸型打勾，挤出型打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two clear plastic sheets, a cast sheet with a tick and an extruded sheet with a bad smell cloud crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 亚克力分挤出型和浇铸型。

shots.scene: 挤出型加工时冒出大股气味
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an extruded sheet giving off a strong smell cloud while being processed. No text.
shots.narration: 挤出型气味大，按清单不再允许。

shots.scene: 购物页面的标签、描述、规格都放大查看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifying glass over the label, the description and the specification table of a product page. No text.
shots.narration: 购买时，找明确写着浇铸的说明。

shots.scene: 签到时出示证明，没有证明的板子放回
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows a printed proof at the sign in desk, while a sheet without proof is set aside.
shots.narration: 签到时出示证明，拿不出就不能用。

shots.scene: 标明植鞣的真皮打勾，铬鞣皮革打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a genuine leather piece marked vegetable tanned with a tick, and a chrome tanned piece crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 皮革须是标明植鞣的真皮。

shots.scene: 人造革冒浓烟，过滤器吃不消，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an artificial leather sheet giving off thick smoke that overwhelms a filter, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 人造革一律不行，烟气多还常含氯。

shots.scene: 木砧板等成品件，说明写着可激光加工和材质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: finished items such as a wooden board and a coaster, each with a label showing a laser icon and a material icon. No text.
shots.narration: 成品件要写明可激光加工和材质。

shots.scene: 刷漆、染色的成品件打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a painted and dyed finished item crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 还要确认没上漆、没染色。

shots.scene: 一块含氯塑料板，红色禁止符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chlorine containing plastic sheet under a large red prohibition symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 含氯材料，严禁激光加工。

shots.scene: 含氯塑料受热，冒出有毒腐蚀性气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chlorine containing plastic giving off toxic corrosive gas clouds when heated. No text.
shots.narration: 受热放出氯化氢等有毒腐蚀气体。

shots.scene: 气体伤人肺部，也腐蚀机器的镜片和导轨
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the gas harming a pair of lungs and corroding the lenses and rails of a machine. No text.
shots.narration: 伤人，也腐蚀镜片和机器。

shots.scene: 外观像亚克力的透明板，打问号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two identical looking clear sheets, one of them hiding a chlorine symbol, with a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 有些塑料，看着和亚克力一模一样。

shots.scene: 成分说不清的透明板打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear sheet with unknown composition, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 成分说不清的，一律不切。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着板子去问小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a doubtful sheet over to the female graduate student to ask.
shots.narration: 拿不准，先问管理人员。

shots.scene: 阿杰填写空白的新材料申请表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank new material request form.
shots.narration: 想用清单外的新材料，先申请。

shots.scene: 王老师查资料评估，评估后再决定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a safety data sheet and the request form before deciding.
shots.narration: 评估安全后，再决定能不能用。

shots.section_title: 焊接切割烟尘：排风加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 金属焊接冒出烟尘，烟里有细小颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: metal welding fumes rising, with tiny particles drawn inside the smoke. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接烟尘可能含有有毒颗粒。
overlay: 焊接切割烟尘：排风加呼吸防护

shots.section_title: 焊接切割烟尘：排风加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 焊接台上方局部排风罩把烟吸走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a local exhaust hood above a welding table drawing the fumes away. No text.
shots.narration: 排烟设备开着，才能焊接。

shots.section_title: 焊接切割烟尘：排风加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 金属切割的烟尘也被吸走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fumes from handheld metal cutting being drawn into an extraction arm. No text.
shots.narration: 金属切割有烟尘，同样要排走。

shots.section_title: 焊接切割烟尘：排风加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 阿杰戴上防颗粒物呼吸器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a particulate respirator before welding.
shots.narration: 操作者还要戴好呼吸防护用品。

shots.section_title: 焊接切割烟尘：排风加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 呼吸器检查佩戴气密性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person pressing both hands over a respirator to check the seal. No text.
shots.narration: 按要求选型，戴前查气密。

shots.section_title: 镀层涂层、焊丝和激光清洗：先查成分
shots.scene: 镀锌板和刷漆工件冒出更浓的烟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a galvanised plate and a painted workpiece giving off thicker, darker fumes. No text.
shots.narration: 镀层、涂层工件，烟尘危害更大。
overlay: 镀层涂层、焊丝和激光清洗：先查成分

shots.section_title: 镀层涂层、焊丝和激光清洗：先查成分
shots.scene: 不明工件打叉，排风开足
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unknown coated part crossed out, and an exhaust fan turned up to full. No text.
shots.narration: 先确认材料，不明材料不焊。

shots.section_title: 镀层涂层、焊丝和激光清洗：先查成分
shots.scene: 焊丝盘旁边放着空白的安全数据单
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spool of welding wire beside a blank safety data sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 每种焊丝，先看安全数据单。

shots.section_title: 镀层涂层、焊丝和激光清洗：先查成分
shots.scene: 激光清洗扬起锈和涂层粉尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: laser cleaning lifting rust and paint dust into the air, the operator wearing goggles and a respirator. No text.
shots.narration: 激光清洗扬起粉尘，防护一样不少。

shots.section_title: 排烟全程开，烟散尽再开盖
shots.scene: 开机前先开排烟净化器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume extractor switched on before the laser cutter is started. No text.
shots.narration: 开机前，先开排烟和过滤。
overlay: 排烟全程开，烟散尽再开盖

shots.section_title: 排烟全程开，烟散尽再开盖
shots.scene: 排风没开，启动键打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume extractor switched off and the start button crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 排风没开，不得加工。

shots.section_title: 排烟全程开，烟散尽再开盖
shots.scene: 辅助吹气吹走火苗和烟渣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an air assist stream at the cutting head blowing away small flames and smoke residue. No text.
shots.narration: 按提示开辅助吹气，减少火苗烟渣。

shots.section_title: 排烟全程开，烟散尽再开盖
shots.scene: 排烟管接口密封严实
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume duct joint wrapped and sealed tightly, no smoke leaking out. No text.
shots.narration: 排烟管要接好、密封。

shots.section_title: 排烟全程开，烟散尽再开盖
shots.scene: 加工结束，机内还有烟，开盖的手打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the job finished, smoke still inside the closed machine, a hand lifting the lid crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 加工完稍等，看不到烟再开盖。

shots.section_title: 排烟全程开，烟散尽再开盖
shots.scene: 废料抽屉清空，旁边无易燃物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scrap drawer being emptied, no flammable items around the machine. No text.
shots.narration: 废料及时清，旁边不放易燃物。

shots.section_title: 闻到异味就停，滤芯按时换
shots.scene: 【实拍】净化器风量调到规定档位，指示灯亮格特写（设备不加工）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a fume extractor control panel with the airflow level indicator lamps lit.
shots.narration: 净化器风量调到规定档位。
overlay: 闻到异味就停，滤芯按时换

shots.section_title: 闻到异味就停，滤芯按时换
shots.scene: 加工中闻到异味，阿杰按下暂停
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a strong smell during processing and presses the pause button.
shots.narration: 闻到明显异味，先暂停。

shots.section_title: 闻到异味就停，滤芯按时换
shots.scene: 小研检查风管和风量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the duct connections and the airflow of the extractor.
shots.narration: 报告管理人员，检查风量风管。

shots.section_title: 闻到异味就停，滤芯按时换
shots.scene: 【实拍】管理人员打开净化器检查滤芯（设备停机）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a technician opening a fume extractor and inspecting the filter cartridge.
shots.narration: 滤芯堵了就停机，由管理人员更换。

shots.section_title: 加工烟尘是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 工作场所里飘着烟尘，旁边一个健康体检图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fumes drifting in a workshop beside a health check icon. No text.
shots.narration: 加工烟尘，属于职业病危害因素。
overlay: 加工烟尘是职业病危害因素

shots.section_title: 加工烟尘是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 排风、密闭、呼吸防护三个图标排序
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three ranked icons, local exhaust first, an enclosed machine second and a respirator last. No text.
shots.narration: 先排风密闭，再个人防护。

shots.section_title: 加工烟尘是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 经常操作的人参加职业健康检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a regular operator having a health check with a doctor. No text.
shots.narration: 经常操作的人，按规定体检。

shots.scene: 清单、凭证、禁止的含氯塑料三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an approved list, a material label and a crossed out chlorine plastic sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 看清单、查凭证，含氯材料不切。

shots.scene: 排风扇、呼吸器、等烟散的时钟三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an exhaust fan, a respirator and a clock waiting for the smoke to clear. No text.
shots.narration: 排风全程开，烟散尽再开盖。

shots.scene: 鼻子闻到异味、暂停按钮、滤芯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nose sensing a smell, a pause button and a filter cartridge. No text.
shots.narration: 闻到异味就停，滤芯按时换。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光设备旁，设备侧板上有当心触电标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laser machine with an electric warning sign on its side panel and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光设备高压与维护安全。
